baseline_models.mechanism: The same agent who originated the referent is named as its reviver, while firstness plus a counted occurrence frames origination as an act that can occur again.

activation_trace.role: Life as the state of a living, ensouled being supplies the state that the verb restores.
Bringing a thing into existence supplies the prior origination used as the operative precedent.
Beginning and temporal precedence mark the cited origination as the first event.
A temporal occurrence that admits counting and repetition turns first creation into occurrence one.

changed_reading.before: He can revive the bones because He is powerful.
changed_reading.after: The first origination is presented as the first counted occurrence of an act by the same agent, so revival is repeat origination rather than repair by an unrelated process.

baseline_models.mechanism: Comprehensive knowledge is attached specifically to creation, whose branch inventory includes prior measuring and specification; the assurance concerns exhaustive command of every created configuration.

activation_trace.role: Allness as enclosing completeness gives the knowledge claim exhaustive scope.
Measuring and proportioning before execution makes creation a knowable specification, not only a finished object.
The thing's disclosure to the knower supplies complete cognitive access to every specification.

changed_reading.before: The closing adjective is a general assertion of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The closing clause answers the identity problem of revival: every created configuration is exhaustively known in its measure and can therefore be re-instantiated.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus verbs can overlap in a developmental model: life emerges and is nurtured through stages, so the first creation need not be reduced to a single instantaneous event.

activation_trace.role: Earth becoming alive through rain and vegetation supplies a process image for renewed life.
A youth's growth and upbringing makes origination a staged emergence and maturation.
A completed and proportioned form supplies the endpoint toward which emergence develops.

changed_reading.before: Revival means an instantaneous switch from death to life.
changed_reading.after: Revival can also be heard as renewed emergence toward a known completed form, continuous with the staged character of first development.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier coordination of reviving the dead with inscribing deeds, retaining traces, and exhaustive enumeration turns divine knowledge into a continuity mechanism: what identifies a life is not lost when its body is dispersed.

activation_trace.role: Complete disclosure to the knower anchors the model in the focus claim of knowledge.
Enclosing completeness requires that no identity-bearing remainder fall outside the knowledge claim.
Inscription as fixed establishment supplies durable registration rather than passing recollection.
A remaining mark that discloses what was supplies identity-bearing continuity after the actor is absent.
Enumeration by exhaustive counting makes preservation comprehensive rather than selective.

structural_cues: 36:12 places reviving the dead, writing what they advanced, retaining their traces, and enumerating every thing in one coordinated statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revival plus durable, exhaustive records; I infer that those records can secure personal continuity across bodily loss. A live alternative is that the record serves judgment only and says nothing about the mechanics of re-creation.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge of creation means knowing how bodies are constructed.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge of every creation includes preservation of the particular life's deeds and traces, so revival can restore an identified history rather than merely generate an equivalent body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dead-earth sequence makes revival productive emergence: life returns, concealed material comes out, and seed becomes sustenance. The later growth branch extends that process image from vegetation toward human formation.

activation_trace.role: Reviving land through rain and vegetation anchors the focus verb in germinative life.
Growth and upbringing anchor re-origination in staged development.
The explicit life of dead earth supplies the surah's concrete revival process.
Bringing something out of concealment gives revival an emergence phase.
The germinating seed supplies a small latent carrier from which visible life and nourishment unfold.
The branch's extension from sprouting to human growth licenses a cautious cross-domain bridge to bodily emergence.

structural_cues: 36:33 orders dead earth, revivification, extraction, seed, and eating as a causal sequence.
36:36 places what the earth grows beside human selves and unknown created pairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an agricultural emergence sequence and a branch linking growth to human upbringing; I map that process onto bodily revival. The alternative is a power analogy only, with no implication that resurrection itself unfolds germinatively.

changed_reading.before: Reviving the bones is assembly of visibly remaining pieces.
changed_reading.after: Revival may be renewed emergence from concealed, minimal material toward a known mature form, like productive life issuing from dead ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cosmic signs define created things by measured courses, stations, return, and orbit. Knowledge of every creation thus includes its temporal trajectory, not only a static blueprint.

activation_trace.role: Prior measurement anchors creation as an ordered specification.
Knowledge supplies complete access to the created thing's ordered course.
Continuous running makes a creation legible as motion through a course.
A fixed station gives the course an appointed terminus.
Ordering by measure and deliberation supplies the rule governing the trajectory.
Return after departure and repetition after beginning makes the measured course recurrent.
Circularity and rotation give recurrent passage a spatial mechanism.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 moves from the sun's course and station to the moon's measured stages and return, then says each moves in an orbit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calibrated motion, stations, return, and orbit; I infer that a created identity can be known as a full trajectory whose revival is another appointed phase. The alternative is that these verses demonstrate order generally without modeling personal return.

changed_reading.before: Every creation is known as a completed object.
changed_reading.after: Every creation is known through its measured course, transformations, and return, so revival belongs inside an ordered trajectory rather than interrupting it from outside.

context_deltas.mechanism: The resurrection scene supplies a dynamic sequence: a signal enters, stillness is stirred, bodies separate rapidly from graves, and the dispersed become a gathered presence.

activation_trace.role: Restoration to ensouled life anchors the context sequence in the focus verb.
Sending air into something supplies the initiating signal and inward impulse.
The grave supplies the bounded location from which revived bodies emerge.
Rapid impulsive movement turns revival into mobilization rather than static animation.
Stirring what was stationary from repose names the transition out of deathlike stillness.
Sleep and stillness recode the prior state as interruptible repose.
Joining what was dispersed completes the process as regathered presence.

structural_cues: 36:51-53 orders trumpet blast, motion out of graves, recognition of awakening, a second single cry, and collective presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the states and their sequence; I infer a process arrow from signal to stirring to rapid emergence to gathering. The live alternative is that the sequence narrates events without specifying how life itself is restored.

changed_reading.before: He revives each decayed body in place.
changed_reading.after: Revival is a coordinated remobilization and regathering: repose is interrupted, bounded remains emerge, and dispersed persons become present together.

context_deltas.mechanism: Adjacent examples show form as transformable and temporally directed: a body may be converted in place, and extended life reverses a person within creation. Revival becomes another directed transformation of a known form.

activation_trace.role: Passage and going-through anchor life as movement through successive states.
Formed and proportioned appearance anchors the model in the focus noun creation.
Conversion and deformation of created shape demonstrates that embodied form can change in place.
Extension of life supplies the temporal axis along which bodily form changes.
Turning a thing upside down supplies the reversal operator within the life course.
The explicit placement of reversal within formed creation ties the state change directly to the focus anchor.

structural_cues: 36:67 contrasts transformation in place with inability to move forward or return.
36:68 makes prolonged life cause reversal within creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed bodily transformations; I infer that resurrection can be modeled as a sovereign redirection through a space of known forms. The alternative is that aging and deformation only expose human weakness and do not model revival.

changed_reading.after: Creation is a succession of transformable forms, and revival is a new directed transition toward the known living form rather than a mechanical rewind.

context_deltas.mechanism: The objector isolates the discontinuity from bone to life but forgets the prior discontinuity from a drop to an articulate adversary. The decay root's inventory also juxtaposes disintegration with repair, making terminal ruin a reversible condition rather than a final category.

activation_trace.role: Initial bringing-into-existence anchors the comparison with the person's own first discontinuous emergence.
The first beginning directs attention back to the omitted origin.
A minute drop including generative fluid supplies the materially remote starting state.
Active disputation supplies the highly developed social and linguistic endpoint produced from that drop.
Loss of recollection identifies the cognitive omission that makes the second discontinuity look impossible.
Decay and disintegration supply the terminal condition emphasized by the objection.
Repair of what has become corrupt supplies an exploratory polarity inside the same root inventory.

structural_cues: 36:77 compresses the transition from drop to manifest disputant with a sudden-result construction.
36:78 explicitly says the speaker forgot his own creation before asking about decayed bones.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the forgotten first transformation and the decay/repair branch polarity; I infer that the reply corrects a selective comparison between discontinuities. The repair branch may be inactive in the surface form رميم, so the safer alternative is that only first origination proves the second.

changed_reading.before: The answer merely repeats that creation once happened before.
changed_reading.after: The answer restores the suppressed comparison: drop-to-disputant was already a greater visible discontinuity, and even the vocabulary of decay leaves a live repairward branch.

context_deltas.mechanism: The green-tree sign presents one material as carrier of apparently contrary states: moist living growth yields kindled fire. The same maker can release a state that surface conditions seem to exclude.

activation_trace.role: Vegetative life anchors the focus verb in the living side of the material reversal.
Measured formation anchors contrary states in a single created substrate.
Causing a thing to assume a state supplies the transformation operator.
The trunked tree supplies the common material carrier.
Fresh green vegetation supplies the moist, living state that seems opposed to combustion.
Kindled fire supplies the contrary state released from the green substrate.
Ignition turns the latent contrast into an enacted transition available to the addressees.

structural_cues: 36:80 immediately follows the focus answer and moves from green tree to fire to the addressees' present act of kindling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a substrate and an apparently contrary produced state; I infer a material analogy in which decay does not exhaust what a body can be made to yield. The alternative is a general sign of power, not a claim that life is materially latent in bones.

changed_reading.before: Decay must be undone before life can return.
changed_reading.after: A created substrate may be made to release a state that its present surface seems to exclude; revival is contrary-state actualization, not necessarily prior-condition reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The commanded reply قل is later echoed by divine saying whose result is occurrence. This gives the focus answer a formal enactment: human speech states the answer, while divine speech effects the transition the answer asserts.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance supplies the focus response's explicit speech act.
An obligating command supplies directive force rather than description alone.
Will and intention supply the condition initiating the command.
Uttered saying links the divine command formally to the focus imperative قل.
Occurrence and presence in time supply both commanded state and immediate result.

structural_cues: 36:82 orders will, address to a thing, the imperative كن, and the result فيكون as a compact command-result chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel acts of saying and a divine command-result sequence; I infer a formal echo between قل and يقول له كن. The alternative is categorical: the first is ordinary reporting, while only the latter is efficacious speech.

changed_reading.before: قل merely introduces a verbal explanation of resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The reply's speech form anticipates the surah's command-event mechanism: the messenger's saying announces revival, and divine saying makes the created state occur.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a judicial testimony scene is recruited as an identity-continuity mechanism. It remains anchored in عَلِيمٌ and خَلْقٍ because created limbs disclose acquired history when mouths are sealed. Downstream prose should call it an exploratory witness-bearing-body model, not a claim of literal biological memory.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge anchors complete access to what the created person has become and done.
Intelligible speech by the hands makes bodily members active conveyors of personal history.
Testimony as disclosure from knowledge turns the feet into evidence-bearing created parts.
Acquisitive bodily organs connect embodied action to the history later disclosed.

changed_reading.before: The recreated body is a passive vessel known from outside.
changed_reading.after: The created body may itself bear and disclose the person's acquired history, giving عَلِيمٌ an embodied identity-preservation dimension.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets a return branch of ء و ل resonate under surface أَوَّل and joins it to passage, lunar return, and final return. It remains anchored in أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ, but downstream prose must present it as branch resonance rather than claim that أَوَّل lexically means return here.

activation_trace.role: Return to an outcome or end lets firstness carry a faint orientation toward what it will come back to.
Passage and traversal make the first occurrence the opening leg of a temporal route.
Return after departure and repetition after a beginning supplies an ordered recurrent example.
Being returned to what was before supplies the surah's terminal orientation back to the source.

changed_reading.before: First time points only backward to an isolated past event.
changed_reading.after: First passage can be heard as opening a return-bearing arc whose later phase is revival and whose endpoint is return to the source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts continuity from recovery of identical particles toward recreation through a known likeness-pattern. It remains anchored in خَلْقٍ and عَلِيمٌ and in the following verse's repeated creation language plus مِثْل. Downstream prose should mark this as a pattern-continuity possibility, not settle whether مِثْلَهُم refers to recreated humans or another comparison target.

activation_trace.role: Measured specification anchors identity in a reproducible form-pattern.
Repeated creative bringing-into-existence supplies the generative act at both cosmic and comparative scales.
Effective capacity supplies the ability to realize the comparative pattern.
Likeness and correspondence supply pattern continuity without requiring visibly continuous material.
Knowledge repeated beside intensive creating secures exact access to the pattern being realized.

changed_reading.before: Revival requires collection of the very same surviving material.
changed_reading.after: The known creative pattern may preserve identity through like-formed re-creation even when material continuity is not visible.

strongest_changes: The focus answer became an identity-preservation claim: exhaustive knowledge includes durable deeds and traces, not merely generic omniscience.
The forgotten drop-to-disputant transition made first creation a concrete discontinuity comparable to bone-to-life, while the decay root retained an exploratory repair polarity.
The green-tree/fire sign recast revival as release of an apparently contrary state from a created substrate.
The trumpet-to-gathering sequence turned revival from static repair into coordinated stirring, emergence, motion, and regathering.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context converted the short answer from a bare argument from prior power into several coexisting mechanisms: specification-preserving re-instantiation, germinative emergence, trajectory completion, bodily remobilization, reversible formation, contrary-state release, and command becoming occurrence.
remaining_uncertainties: The ledger and bodily-testimony cues may concern judgment without describing how personal identity is physically restored.
Agricultural growth may function only as analogy, not as a process model for resurrection.
The repair branch under ر م م, the return resonance under ء و ل, and likeness-pattern continuity are branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The formal echo between قل and كن does not erase the categorical difference between reported human speech and efficacious divine command.
